verdict.rationale: Abacum's investor-reporting page claims the deck builds itself from actuals with no copy-paste between model and slides, which implies slide output. Its Excel connector lets users push and pull data between Abacum and Excel, which covers spreadsheet-format movement of data. Missing for 10: any documentation of PDF export, explicit export-to-slides mechanics (format or destination such as PowerPoint/Google Slides), report-level export as opposed to data sync, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
